{{Quote|This mission hasn't gone so well, has it friends. My crew? Did you save my crew?|Captain Alain Gryphon|<ref name="O" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Alain Gryphon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who commanded the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Mutiny on the Celestial|taken over]] by the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] she was transporting to an Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]], and an accident sent the ''Celestial'' into [[otherspace]]. Gryphon and her crew were taken aboard the [[Charon/Legends|Charon's]] vessel, the ''[[Desolate]]''. Gryphon was badly [[Skirmish on the Desolate|wounded]] by the Charon's [[Charon venom|poison]]-tipped claws, and she [[Death/Legends|died]] in the ship's [[growing chamber]] shortly after meeting an Alliance team that had also been dragged into otherspace.
